title: BSU Rector Meets with Student Council Members

blocks.text: On April 4, 2025, the rector of Bishkek State University Mirlan Dyldaev held a meeting with members of the student council. During the event, a frank and friendly exchange of opinions took place. Students shared their proposals and expressed ideas regarding the educational process and student life. The meeting was also attended by the vice-rector for the state language Azamat Satiyev and the director of the Department of Youth Affairs Eldiyar Kurmanbek uulu, who also conducted an open dialogue with the students. Rector Mirlan Dyldaev highly appreciated the students' activity and emphasized that the university management is always ready for an open dialogue and support for student initiatives. This meeting was an important step in strengthening mutual understanding between students and the administration, as well as in the direction of the university's development.
